Both assistants correctly categorize the four questions. However, Assistant B adheres more strictly to the instruction to “refrain from uttering any extraneous words” and to “list only one topic per sentence” in a line‑by‑line format. Assistant A includes numbering (1., 2., etc.), which adds unnecessary characters, while Assistant B provides only the category names, each on its own line with a simple period. Therefore, Assistant B better follows the user’s formatting constraints.

[[B]]
